criteria.statement: Given a job submission that returns status: "queued", when translate() polls and the job eventually reports status: "complete", writeLocaleFileTree is called once with the localeFileTree from the final complete response
criteria.test: packages/cli/src/__tests__/translate.test.ts::translate() orchestrator (mocked) > calls writeLocaleFileTree with the final localeFileTree after submit → poll(running) → poll(complete)

criteria.statement: Given a submission that returns status: "complete" immediately, translate() calls writeLocaleFileTree directly from the submit response without ever calling pollTranslateStatus
criteria.test: packages/cli/src/__tests__/translate.test.ts::translate() orchestrator (mocked) > writes files directly from an immediately-cached submit response without polling

criteria.statement: Given a completed job with multiple apps (monorepo), translate() calls writeLocaleFileTree once per app with that app's own locale file tree, not a merged or swapped one
criteria.test: packages/cli/src/__tests__/translate.test.ts::translate() orchestrator (mocked) > writes each monorepo app's own locale tree independently

criteria.statement: Given a completed job, translate() finishes successfully and returns exit code 0
criteria.test: packages/cli/src/__tests__/translate.test.ts::translate() orchestrator (mocked) > calls writeLocaleFileTree with the final localeFileTree after submit → poll(running) → poll(complete)

criteria.statement: Given a final response where one app has no localeFileTree (zero translatable strings), writeLocaleFileTree is skipped for that app rather than called with undefined
criteria.test: packages/cli/src/__tests__/translate.test.ts::translate() orchestrator (mocked) > skips writeLocaleFileTree for an app with no locale tree
